propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED commit reachable from HEAD, when the implementation accepts any commit (merged or local) reachable from current HEAD that carries a rebar-ticket trailer for the ticket or any transitive descendant.

The close precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and completion-verification gate settings, but the documentation presents it as unconditional and omits the conditional gates (file_impact, require_completion_verification_for_close, --force-close, replacement links).
AGENTS.md fails to document rebar transition --ref, the correct mechanism for closing stacked stories against their own commit while the worktree remains at the epic tip.
The real ordering rule enforcing land-before-close is the Verified +1 policy, not the precheck mechanism, but the documentation implies the precheck enforces it.

The --ref flag retargets completion verification and signature to a specified ref's tree but does not narrow the referencing-commit scan, a distinction the documentation must clarify to avoid substituting one wrong mechanism for another.
